name: Task List
implementation_notes: NULLS LAST sort (both asc/desc) implemented in task-service.js by partitioning rows with/without dueDate and appending undated rows last regardless of direction — avoids raw SQL workarounds.
id/timestamps generated via Prisma schema defaults (@default(uuid()), @default(now()), @updatedAt), not app code.
StatusBadge.vue implements the inline status-change control as click-to-cycle (todo -> in_progress -> done -> todo) on a badge-styled button, with optimistic update + revert-on-failure.
FE toast implemented inline in TaskListView.vue (small reactive state + timeout) rather than a separate composable, since toast ownership is scoped there per spec.

Error codes reuse the existing error-handler.js createError(status, code, message) helper; ad-hoc codes DELETE_FAILED, UPDATE_FAILED, INVALID_STATUS added alongside VALIDATION_ERROR/NOT_FOUND/INTERNAL_ERROR.

SortControl.vue's internal order ref starts at 'desc' so the first toggle (which flips before emitting) requests 'asc' — matching the spec's 'activate sort -> ascending first' requirement; this was a bug in the first generation pass, fixed before this write.

TaskListView.vue now shows a distinct 'No tasks match this filter.' message when a status filter yields zero results, separate from 'No tasks yet.' for a truly empty list — added header-add-task and empty-state-add-task data-testid attributes to disambiguate the two 'Add Task' buttons for testing.

Playwright browser test infra added from scratch for this screen: frontend/playwright.config.js (webServer runs `npm run dev`, chromium project) and @playwright/test devDependency + test:e2e script in frontend/package.json — no prior browser test setup existed in the project.

Two Playwright test-authoring bugs from the first generation pass were corrected before this write: a Jest-style expect.stringMatching() wrapper inside toHaveText() (replaced with a plain RegExp) and an ambiguous 'Add Task' role locator that matched two buttons (replaced with data-testid locators).

known_issues.description: Root package.json has "scripts.install": "npm install", which causes infinite recursion if a bare `npm install` is run at the repo root (must use `npm install --ignore-scripts` or fix the script). Pre-existing from project.4-implement.scaffold — out of scope for this screen.
